##### Project general facts

Alexis Tower is a striking modern residential building that brings together vibrant, contemporary living with everyday convenience and comfort. It offers a collection of 370 beautifully designed apartments, each fully equipped with exceptional facilities to suit a wide range of lifestyles. Residents can enjoy a buzzing yet relaxing atmosphere, making this address a truly special place to call home.

Life at Alexis Tower is enriched by a wonderful array of amenities designed for both leisure and wellbeing. Residents can take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, let little ones enjoy the dedicated kids' pool, or stay active in the fully equipped gymnasium. Beautifully landscaped gardens, convenient retail areas, generous covered parking and four large lifts add an extra layer of comfort and ease to daily living.

Every apartment at Alexis Tower is a true reflection of refined taste, finished with careful attention to every detail. Comfortable, well-lit interiors are complemented by elegant bathrooms with premium fittings, stylish vanity units and mirrors, and quality tiling throughout. Welcoming, thoughtfully designed spaces come together to create warm, sophisticated homes that residents will love returning to.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world’s largest container hubs, which has cemented the area’s global significance in trade and commerce.

Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents.

The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.
